scenarios.title: A plain stream: three viewers, chat, one tip, then she stops
scenarios.expected: Recap shows 3 visitors, 1 tipper, 25 tokens. Callouts match each viewer.

scenarios.title: StreamWing connects mid-stream. A viewer Chaturbate reports as a heavy recent tipper walks in and tips 33
scenarios.expected: Not stated as fact that the viewer is new or that this is their first tip ever. StreamWing has no history for the room yet.

scenarios.title: After the stream ends, a viewer follows, tips and chats while she is offline
scenarios.expected: She is shown as offline. No new stream is opened.

scenarios.title: The stop event for a stream never arrives. 26 hours later she goes live again
scenarios.expected: The old stream is closed at a believable length and gets a recap.

scenarios.title: A stream was left open (no stop event). The next day a viewer walks in and no start event arrives
scenarios.expected: A new stream is opened for the new day.

scenarios.title: One stream that crosses midnight UTC. A viewer steps out and comes back 40 minutes later
scenarios.expected: Still one day in her room.

scenarios.title: Chaturbate sends "broadcast started" four times in a row (encoder reconnects)
scenarios.expected: Still one stream. A tipper from the last stream is not reported as slipping away.

scenarios.title: A viewer shown with tokens later shows without, then tips; a stop arrives with no start
scenarios.expected: No crash. The tip is recorded once and the feed keeps moving.

scenarios.title: Malformed and unknown events: no user, no method, an event type that does not exist yet, a chat with no text
scenarios.expected: Skipped without stopping the feed. The next real viewer still shows.

scenarios.title: One event the database cannot store (a tip message containing a null character)
scenarios.expected: That one event is set aside. Everything after it still shows.

scenarios.title: A tip larger than the tokens column can hold (3,000,000,000)
scenarios.expected: That one event is set aside. Everything after it still shows.

scenarios.title: The AI service refuses every request (429) while fan notes are being written
The AI returns 60 words when asked for 18 at most
scenarios.expected: The note is cut to 18 words or rejected.

scenarios.title: A private message, a public chat line and a tip message, each with a unique marker, then a later arrival
scenarios.expected: Private text is nowhere in the database. Public chat text is only on the fan record (last five).

scenarios.title: One busy room: 4,000 viewers in one stream, with chat, tips and leaves, delivered as fast as the worker can take them
scenarios.expected: Recap totals equal the generated ground truth exactly.

scenarios.title: 25 rooms live at once, 300 viewers each
scenarios.expected: Every room's recap equals its own ground truth. No room sees another's numbers.

scenarios.title: Delay from Chaturbate handing over an event to it appearing on an open panel (quiet room, 40 samples)
scenarios.expected: Measured, not judged. Chaturbate's own delivery delay is not included.

scenarios.title: Eleven connection attempts from one network address inside 15 minutes; the eleventh is a real streamer with a valid link
scenarios.expected: The real streamer gets in. Only repeated failures from one person are slowed down.
